limitations: True graph hidden from policy, but entire 64-hypothesis universe is supplied; no unseen graph-family transfer

Host CPU varies; matched work does not imply identical timing
Tests establish bounded finite-sample and finite-family correctness, not open-world causality or AGI

proof_scope: Reproduced finite-hypothesis intervention-based causal graph identification on 14 heldout four-register copy-tree ISA structures across five seeds with three interventions each (70 cases and 210 oracle calls per arm). Verified 630 intervention traces and active expected-survivor policy scores independently, 210 evaluation rows, source provenance, matched CPU, negative controls, and bounded confidence interval. Not causal discovery beyond the 64 supplied graph hypotheses; no statistically confirmed improvement over random, no AGI, no champion promotion.
